REQ-022 (withdraw from a registration and free the seat, GitHub issue #25, fourth requirement of Phase 4) had RELEASE-VALIDATOR PASS at Step 5 (commit 7abf0d1, 'chore(handoff): WF02-REQ-022 release validation -- PASS'). Verified the factual claims directly against the real code before writing the status-history note, rather than trusting the task prompt's summary: read apps/bot/src/domain/registration.ts directly and confirmed decideWithdrawOutcome() is a pure first-match-wins table (not-found -> not-owner -> checked-in -> not-eligible -> withdrawn) and withdrawRegistration() performs a SELECT ... FOR UPDATE fresh re-read, decides, and on 'withdrawn' does exactly one UPDATE (admission column only) plus exactly one writeAuditLog call in the same transaction, with every non-withdrawn outcome returning before either write. Read apps/bot/src/handlers/withdraw.ts directly and confirmed the standalone /withdraw <event_id> entry point (interim, since /my/REQ-024 doesn't exist yet), the two-step confirm/cancel inline-keyboard UX, and that makeWithdrawCancelCallbackHandler makes zero domain calls (dismissal-leaves-admission-unchanged true by construction). Read registerForEvent() in the same file (lines 109-248) directly and confirmed the row-reuse-via-UPDATE mechanism precisely: the existing-registration SELECT now also selects `id`; a withdrawn row's admission is normalized to null before decideRegistrationOutcome() (unchanged function) while its id is captured separately and used to branch to an UPDATE (admission/source/qr_token only, id/created_at untouched) instead of INSERT -- confirmed this stays inside the same FOR UPDATE-locked transaction span REQ-020 established (no new lock, no new transaction boundary). Confirmed no schema change (git diff master...HEAD shows no new drizzle migration file). Confirmed docs/agents/requirements.yaml's REQ-022 entry (description + 5 acceptance criteria) already matched the shipped mechanism exactly -- no content correction needed. Confirmed ISS-0019 (docs/issues/ISS-0019.yaml) is two test-spec fixture/count issues only, non-blocking, already filed.
